'''LordVader101 Lightside Lightsaber Combat''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[LordVader101]]
* '''Published:''' 25 September 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif|label=We'll Handle This}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 WHT LordVader101 LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Bionic Hand (V), Princess Leia (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is a deck i have been wanting to put together for awhile, and i finally got the right cards. I hope that i put this deck together well and i appreciate any advice towards making it better.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 62 as published (the section counts also total 62).
* Original-era (V): Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (VS1, posted 'Sal'torr kal fas(v)'); Traffic Control (V) (VS3, shield); Bionic Hand (V) x2, Princess Leia (V) x2 (VS6).
* Many unique cards posted x2–x3 (e.g. Qui-Gon Jinn, Jedi Master x3, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight x3, the named lightsabers); dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

I obviously try to get my jedi out with their sabers to drain the heck out of the opponent and to put combat cards on them so that they can beat down the dark Jedi that come over, I put in Princess Leia to add destiny, and i threw in The Force is strong with this one as a surprise. I have put some pretty good destiny in the deck so i can usually have good pulls just in case anybody wants to come over and just sit back and drain.
